purpose: Provide deterministic translation-only locks along an arbitrary fixed world-space direction while leaving perpendicular translation unconstrained.

properties.locks: bounded explicit body pairs with finite non-zero world-space direction vectors and projected offsets
properties.options: bounded pre/post position and velocity iteration counts

limitations: direction does not rotate with bodies
not a full prismatic or slider joint
standalone v0.1 is not yet integrated into the shared mixed composer/activity/isolation stack
no angular inertia, rotating anchors, angular limits or motors
post-core projection can change positions after donor contact evidence was produced

truth.basis: The capability is named and evidenced as a fixed world-space projected translation constraint, not a rotating local-axis or full prismatic joint.

agency.basis: Callers choose body pair, direction, projected offset, activity state and bounded solver parameters.

continuity.basis: The donor core remains untouched and the new primitive is additive through the existing physics-core export surface.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Mixed-stack integration is explicitly deferred instead of chaining wrappers and risking a hidden second donor-core step.
